task_definition.description: Task 2494 split the curator's system prompts into frozen CONTRACT + editable HEURISTICS and added a one-time refactor safety net in fused-memory/tests/test_task_curator.py: the frozen verbatim copies _PRE_REFACTOR_SYSTEM_PROMPT / _PRE_REFACTOR_BATCH_SYSTEM_PROMPT, plus two superset-of-stripped-lines parity tests that consume them. These exist only to prove the 2494 split dropped no instruction line during that one refactor. They are not a living contract test and must not be extended to track future prompt edits — the in-file comments say so explicitly.
